name: csistmc-portal
description: CSI St. Mark's Church — Portal (Admin CMS + NestJS API). Single source of truth for the public Website.

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,cms -c blue,magenta "npm run start:dev -w @portal/backend" "npm run dev -w @portal/frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run start:dev -w @portal/backend
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run test
